name: thymidylate synthase (TSase), E. coli
notes: EC 2.1.1.45 printed in paper (same as UniProt). Organism from Table 1 title and Fig. 2/Scheme 2 legends ('E. coli TSase'); strain not stated (P0A884 is the K-12 entry). Expression per ref 55 (Changchien et al. 2000). Paper names no residues and no PDB entries. Many WT entries in RCSB (68 entities found by accession P0A884 and by >=90% sequence identity), so pdb left empty; none cites 10.1021/ja103010b. No truncation stated.

name: thymidylate synthase (ecTSase), E. coli
notes: EC printed in paper. Y94 = Tyr94 in P0A884 (GPV[Y]GKQ); named C146, H147, E58, N177 also match. 2FTN and 2FTO: entity sequence = P0A884 with Y94F only (RCSB mutation 'Y94F'); found by accession, >=90% identity and 100% identity to the Y94F sequence; both cite Roberts et al. 2006 (10.1107/S1744309106029691, ref 47); none cites 10.1039/c5cp01246e. Paper's PDB assignment is inconsistent: Introduction 'WT and mutant, PDB IDs 2FTO and 1TYS, respectively' vs Fig. 4 legend 'WT 1TYS, Y94F 2FTO'; RCSB supports Fig. 4 (1TYS: no mutation listed, but its sequence has Ser146 by my alignment). Also names 1TLS (WT). Expressed in E. coli ΔthyA-BL21(DE3); no truncation stated.

name: Escherichia coli thymidylate synthase (ecTSase)
notes: EC printed in paper. Y209 = Tyr209 in P0A884 (GDTHL[Y]SNH). 2G8X (Y209W apoprotein; RCSB mutation field 'Y209W, N-terminus is carbamylated', not engineered; no citation) and 4GEV (Y209W with substrate and cofactor analog; cites 10.1021/ja307859m = ref 15); both = P0A884 with Y209W only; none cites 10.3390/ijms16047304. Paper names 2G80 (WT) and 2G8M (Y209W) ternary complexes with dUMP and CB3717: 2G8M is obsolete, replaced by 4GEV; 2G80 is a yeast UTR4 protein, not TSase (probably 2G8O, an obsolete WT E. coli TSase-dUMP-CB3717 entry). Also names 2KCE (WT). No truncation stated.

name: E. coli thymidylate synthase (TSase)
notes: Paper gives no EC; 2.1.1.45 from UniProt. R166 = Arg166 in P0A884 (CQLYQ[R]SCD); C146, N177, W80, Y209 also match. No RCSB entry for R166K (accession search, >=90% identity search, 100% identity to the R166K sequence); RCSB has R166Q only (1FFL, 1FWM). Paper names WT structures 1TLS, 1TSN, 3BHL, 1KZI, 2G8O (2G8O obsolete). No entry cites 10.1021/acscatal.5b01332. No truncation stated.

name: human thymidylate synthase (hsTSase)
notes: Paper gives no EC; 2.1.1.45 from UniProt. Recombinant from TYMS gene, His6-hsTSase in pET28a(+) expressed in E. coli BL21(DE3); His6 tag removed by thrombin (residual linker residues not stated); no truncation stated; lacks post-translational modifications (expressed in E. coli, per paper). Named residue C195 (nucleophile) = Cys195 in P04818. Many WT entries in RCSB (69 entities in 61 entries by accession P04818 and >=90% identity), so pdb left empty; paper names 1HVY (hs) and 2KCE (ec); none cites 10.1371/journal.pone.0196506.
